authority_chain.binding: stable ref ID -> per-revision semantic re-resolution -> resolved signature -> actual FreeCAD/OCCT BRep cut

bounded_scope: one stable semantic face reference drives an actual authoritative through-hole BRep operation rather than metadata-only rebinding
R001 80x50x10 mm resolves the top face at [40,25,10] and applies a 3 mm radius through-hole
R002 width change to 100 mm changes the resolved descriptor/signature and rebinds the same reference to [50,25,10]
R003 applies 2 mm fillets to all four vertical source edges, changes topology/signature again, then re-resolves the same reference at [50,25,10] and applies the same operation
each applied revision remains a valid single solid and removes pi*r^2*height volume within tolerance
R004 ambiguous top-face resolution returns AMBIGUOUS_HOLD with zero mutation
R005 missing compatible reference returns MISSING_HOLD with zero mutation
HOLD cases preserve the last known good semantic signature
FaceN, EdgeN, VertexN and concrete subshape ordinal persistence are prohibited
FCStd, R001/R002/R003 STEP and registry JSON persist reference, selector, resolved signature and operation lineage
Blender creates three display derivatives and preserves ref/selector/operation IDs, signatures, radius, source FCStd hash and DISPLAY_DERIVATIVE_ONLY authority across save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate if the stable semantic reference is replaced by concrete subshape ordinals, ambiguous/missing resolution mutates geometry, width/topology revisions stop re-resolving before the BRep operation, source/result volume gates are removed, FreeCAD/OCCT route changes without revalidation, or Blender save/reopen no longer preserves the semantic binding and display-only authority.
authority_note: This receipt proves one bounded semantic-reference-bound BRep operation across a dimensional revision and one bounded topology-changing fillet revision, including fail-closed ambiguous/missing resolution. It does not establish persistent topological naming parity or general face/edge/vertex reference stability, and P0-B remains blocked.
